title: 第一百三十八章 荒神苏醒第一百三十七 献祭
content_zh:
第一百三十八章荒神苏醒
很明显，了因与王书恒一般，体内还有另外一个古老的灵魂存在。
有人已经认出来，这人是当年西行到佛国天华国菩提寺取回真经，然后自悟创出佛门禅宗的那位老前辈，他是静心禅院的建造者，法号慧空。
王湛看了看了因，眼中泛起复杂之色，他们同样都是老怪物，但显然慧空更走在他之上。
他将自己的过去佛身，与现下了因所悟的佛门大道融合，成就了佛门最为厉害的功德金身。
此时慧空的身上，释放出来佛门金光。
纵然是佛门祖庭菩提寺，古往今来也没几人能与之相提并论的。
萧凉并不知道慧空，但听着周围的人谈论，不由暗暗咂舌。
这个慧空，在这方世界是堪比达摩祖师的存在，同时还做了唐三藏干的活。
只是达摩祖师是来中土传佛门之法，而慧空则是西行取真经，打造属于自己的佛门。
不管他是何身份，他来到了这里，就足以证明事情的严重性。
否则这些老家伙，平时里面要见一面，何其困难。
萧凉没去打招呼，他此时也不知道该叫他了因，还是慧空。
“阿弥陀佛，凌云真人您还要看戏吗？”慧空声音落下，霎时间，只见虚空中又多了一个道人。
他穿着青色的道袍，须发花白，背上背着一把长剑，手持拂尘，给人以仙风道骨之感。
他是这方世界自然观的创造者，与慧空一般，都是老怪物。
萧凉看着这些老怪物一个个的都显露真身，便知道今日绝对会有大事要发生。
却在这时，有人大声喊道：“你们看，那太阳是不是缺了一块？”
声音传出，几乎所有人都抬头朝着天空中看去。
要是王朝，白日里悬挂在高空的太阳，会很刺眼。

但是今日，非但没有一丁点的刺眼之感，仿佛整个太阳都能清晰地看到。
最为诡异的，左边之处，太阳像是被什么东西给咬掉了一块似的。
“天狗食日？”萧凉声音里面，透着惊讶。
苏清绾面色微微一变，她看着萧凉问道：“你说什么？”
“这莫非是传说中的天狗食日？你怎么了？”萧凉一头雾水，不明白为何苏清绾突然间会有这般变化。
苏清绾神情极为凝重地说道：“天机楼有预言，天狗食日，荒神苏醒。”
“什么？”萧凉只觉得背脊一阵凉飕飕的。
他再次抬头看向天空中的太阳，那缺掉的一块，此时越来越大了。
当此之际，王湛、慧空、凌云真人，与程观策几人同时出手，他们汇聚的力量，化作一道光柱，直冲天空中而去。
太阳缺失的速度，在这时候慢慢降下来。
洛行舟哈哈大笑一声，“布局这么多年，你们以为还能阻止吗？伟大的荒神即将降临人间，为世人赐福，迎来长生。”
“你不要高兴得太早，以目前的情况来看，荒神的苏醒，带来的是破坏毁灭，到时候还能不能活命都不好说。”
萧凉看了一眼洛行舟，冷声说道。
洛行舟冷哼一声，道：“你不会明白的，这个世界太腐朽了，只有彻底的毁灭，才能真正迎来新生。”
“能够做到这一点的，只有创世神荒神。”
第一百三十八章荒神苏醒

Chapter 138: The Abandoned God Awakens
It was obvious that Liao Yin, like Wang Shuheng, had another ancient soul in his body.
Some people have recognized that this man is the old man who traveled west to the Bodhi Temple in the Buddhist Kingdom of Tianhua to retrieve the true scriptures, and then enlightened himself and founded the Zen Buddhism. He is the builder of Jingxin Zen Temple, and his dharma name is Huikong.
Wang Zhan looked at Yin, with a complicated look in his eyes. They were both old monsters, but Huikong was clearly ahead of him.
He merged his past Buddha body with the Buddhist path that he has now realized, and created the most powerful golden body of merit in Buddhism.
At this time, Huikong's body released Buddhist golden light.
Even if it is Bodhi Temple, the ancestral home of Buddhism, few people can compare with it throughout the ages.
Xiao Liang didn't know Huikong, but listening to the people around him talking about it, he couldn't help but secretly click his tongue.
This Huikong is an existence comparable to Patriarch Bodhidharma in this world, and he also did the work that Tang Sanzang did.
It's just that Patriarch Bodhidharma came to China to teach Buddhism, while Huikong traveled west to collect the true scriptures and build his own Buddhism.
Regardless of his identity, his coming here is enough to prove the seriousness of the matter.
Otherwise, it would be extremely difficult for these old guys to meet each other inside.
Xiao Liang didn't go to say hello, and he didn't know whether to call him Er Yin or Huikong at this time.
"Amitabha, Master Lingyun, do you still want to watch the show?" Huikong's voice fell, and in an instant, there was another Taoist in the void.
He was wearing a green Taoist robe, with gray beard and hair, a long sword on his back, and a fly whisk in his hand, giving people the impression of an immortal Taoist.
He is the creator of this world's natural view, and like Huikong, he is an old monster.
Xiao Liang watched these old monsters reveal their true forms one by one, and knew that something big was going to happen today.
But at this moment, someone shouted loudly: "Look, is there a piece of the sun missing?"
When the sound came out, almost everyone looked up towards the sky.
If it were a dynasty, the sun hanging high in the sky during the day would be very dazzling.
But today, not only was there no dazzling feeling at all, it was as if the entire sun could be clearly seen.
The strangest thing is that on the left, the sun seems to have been bitten off by something.
"Tengu eats the sun?" Xiao Liang's voice was full of surprise.
Su Qingwan's expression changed slightly. She looked at Xiao Liang and asked, "What did you say?"
"Could this be the legendary Tengu eating the sun? What's wrong with you?" Xiao Liang was confused and didn't understand why Su Qingwan suddenly changed like this.
Su Qingwan said with a very solemn expression: "There is a prophecy in the Tianji Tower that the Tengu will eat the sun and the wild god will wake up."
"What?" Xiao Liang felt a chill running down his spine.
He looked up at the sun in the sky again. The missing piece was getting bigger and bigger now.
At this moment, Wang Zhan, Huikong, Lingyun Zhenren, and Cheng Guance took action at the same time. The power they gathered turned into a beam of light and shot straight into the sky.
The speed of the sun's disappearance slowly decreased at this time.
Luo Xingzhou laughed loudly, "After all these years of planning, do you think you can still stop it? The great God of Desolation is about to come to the world to bless the world and usher in eternal life."
"Don't be too happy too early. Judging from the current situation, Aragami's awakening will bring destruction and destruction. It's hard to say whether he will survive by then."
Xiao Liang glanced at Luo Xingzhou and said coldly.
Luo Xingzhou snorted coldly and said, "You won't understand. This world is too rotten. Only complete destruction can truly usher in new life."
"The only one who can do this is the God of Creation, Aragami."
